onNavigate.description: Callback invoked when hash navigation should focus a valid node. Receives (nodeId: string). Caller is responsible for calling applyEgoGraph + openDetailPanel.

onInvalidNode.description: Callback invoked when hash contains a node ID not found in nodeMap. Receives (nodeId: string). Caller should show notification and fall back to default view.

initialNodeId.description: The valid node ID from the initial URL hash, or null if no valid deep link was present

nodeId.description: URL-decoded node ID extracted from #node=<value>, or null if hash is malformed/empty

initDeepLink.description: Initialize the deep-link module. Sets up popstate listener for browser back/forward. Returns the initial deep-link node ID if present and valid.

parameters.name: nodeMap
parameters.description: Map of node ID → node data object, used to validate that a hash references an existing node

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Callback handlers for navigation and invalid node events

updateHash.description: Update the URL hash to reflect the currently selected node. Uses history.pushState to avoid triggering popstate/hashchange.

parameters.name: nodeId
parameters.description: The node ID to encode in the hash (e.g., 'virtua-fighter' → '#node=virtua-fighter')

clearHash.description: Remove the hash from the URL when no node is selected. Uses history.pushState to avoid triggering popstate.

parseHash.description: Parse a hash string into a node ID. Exported for testing.
